2607.05147.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
2607.05147.paper_summary: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. Furthermore, indiscriminately verifying these extended blocks wastes critical batch capacity on tokens with high rejection risks, severely degrading throughput in high-concurrency serving systems. We introduce DSpark, a speculative decoding framework that unifies high-throughput parallel generation with adaptive, load-aware verification. To maintain draft quality, DSpark utilizes a semi-autoregressive architecture, coupling a parallel backbone with a lightweight sequential module, to introduce intra-block dependency modeling and mitigate suffix decay. To optimize system efficiency, DSpark employs confidence-scheduled verification, dynamically tailoring the verification length for each request based on estimated prefix survival probabilities and engine-specific throughput profiles. On offline benchmarks across diverse domains, DSpark substantially improves the accepted length over state-of-the-art autoregressive and parallel drafters. When deployed within the DeepSeek-V4 serving system under live user traffic, DSpark successfully mitigates verification waste. Compared to the established production baseline (MTP-1), DSpark accelerates per-user generation speeds by 60 to 85 percent at matched throughput levels. More importantly, by preventing severe throughput degradation under strict interactivity constraints, it enables performance tiers that were previously unattainable, shifting the Pareto frontier of our serving system.
2607.05147.paper_summary_zh: 推測解碼通過將草稿生成與目標驗證解耦，從而加速大型語言模型（LLM）的推理。雖然最近的並行草稿生成器能夠在單次前向傳遞中有效地提出長令牌序列，但由於缺乏令牌間的依賴性，它們面臨著快速接受衰減的問題。此外，對這些擴展區塊的無差別驗證浪費了對於高拒絕風險令牌的關鍵批次容量，嚴重降低了高併發服務系統的吞吐量。我們介紹了DSpark，一個將高吞吐量並行生成與自適應的負載感知驗證統一的推測解碼框架。為了保持草稿質量，DSpark利用半自回歸架構，將並行主幹與輕量級序列模塊結合，以引入區塊內依賴建模並減輕後綴衰減。為了優化系統效率，DSpark採用信心調度驗證，根據估計的前綴存活概率和引擎特定的吞吐量配置動態調整每個請求的驗證長度。在各種領域的離線基準測試中，DSpark顯著提高了接受長度，超過了最先進的自回歸和並行草稿生成器。在DeepSeek-V4服務系統中，在實時用戶流量下部署時，DSpark成功減少了驗證浪費。與既定的生產基線（MTP-1）相比，DSpark在匹配的吞吐量水平下，將每位用戶的生成速度提高了60%至85%。更重要的是，通過防止在嚴格互動約束下的吞吐量嚴重下降，它實現了以前無法達到的性能層級，改變了我們服務系統的帕累托邊界。
